Every Monday at 08:00, starting next Monday, post a 'Coastal week ahead' digest in here from #coastal-team and #coastal-random: anything from the previous week plus open customer items.

@Bettina Kroll I can't set up a recurring Monday 08:00 "Coastal week ahead" post from here. I have no scheduler that runs on its own, so a request like this would just leave a promise I couldn't keep. Two options:

1. Set up a recurring scheduled post in whatever scheduling tool the team already uses, and I can supply the digest content when it fires.
2. Ask me in this thread each Monday and I'll post the digest here. For Monday 19 Oct, I'd pull last week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random (you, Kwame and Sofia are in both) plus the open customer items.

Either way, the digest will leave out money terms such as rates, prices, contract values and invoice amounts. Those can't go into a channel without approval from Anselm or June. Dates, seat counts, renewals and ticket numbers can be included.
